quotes.text: Automation without structure isn't efficiency. It is just technical debt moving at a higher velocity.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Sums up the central problem of ungoverned pipeline sprawl.

quotes.text: Platform governance is proactive. Instead of forbidding bad things, it makes bad things impossible by design rather than by restriction.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Reframes governance as design rather than restriction.

quotes.text: A golden path is an opinionated, well supported way to build and deploy a service.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: A crisp definition of the golden path concept.

quotes.text: Complex decisions still go to humans. If the metrics are technically in bounds, but you're worried about roll out timing because of a holiday weekend, that's a human call. The gate can't make it. Automated gates handle the routine. Humans handle the exceptions.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Clearly separates what automated promotion gates should and should not decide.

quotes.text: Most enterprises should aim for continuous delivery, not continuous deployment. This distinction matters because it shapes how you think about governance, speed and risk.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: A clear recommendation on a frequently confused distinction.

chapters.title: Why enterprise automation fails at scale
Power Platform ALM and low-code governance

takeaways: Copying pipelines between teams creates drift, security gaps and support load; a governed platform with shared templates scales better and costs less.
Ring-based deployments, canary releases and metric-driven promotion gates limit the blast radius while keeping humans for production and exception decisions.
Power Platform governance relies on environments, DLP policies, managed solutions and a center of excellence instead of code review, so citizen developers stay safe by default.
hook: When dozens of teams copy and tweak the same pipelines, CI/CD turns into fragile, expensive technical debt. This episode gives platform, DevOps and Power Platform leaders a governance blueprint built on golden path templates, ring deployments, canary releases and automated gates, plus a phased rollout roadmap.
